policy: Every waiver needs an owner, risk rating, compensating control and expiry; the gate fails on an expired waiver or an UNASSIGNED waiver owner.

waivers.summary: No signature/attestation verification (Sigstore/cosign, node attestation); only digest+provenance allow-listing.
waivers.compensating: verify_artifact digest allow-list; platform admission control
none; edge certification must measure on hardware

waivers.summary: In-process dead letters are volatile across restarts.
waivers.compensating: Outbox for producers; export before planned restart; durable DLQ in INV-53

waivers.summary: PubSub(predicate_view='copy') runtime default kept for 4.2.0 compatibility; config default is 'frozen'. Plan: runtime default -> 'frozen' in 5.0.0.
Direct mutation of PubSub.routes/publishers (4.2.0 style) is tolerated with positional route ids; to be removed in 5.0.0.
A blocking subscriber sink blocks its publisher thread (no internal delivery timeout).
waivers.compensating: sinks must be non-blocking; GuardedSink breaker after failures
